note: Issue #187: who holds each place (src/systems/flow/territory.gd). The seven desert outposts (three out the front gate, four round the other sides) start with the Remnant; killing every trooper at one hands it to the locals, who move in with their own desert guards and a white assassin droid. The locals hold it for hold_s seconds of play; a supply run from Oda (j_supply on the bar board) resets that. When it runs out (or the locals' guards there are all dead) the Remnant take it back, and their troopers return. Holding all seven at once drives the Remnant off the planet: nothing is retaken after that and the locals take the town's barracks too. The barracks also go to the locals when the story is done (the fleet beaten). Issue #303: when every local guard on the barracks posts is dead (control.barracks_dead), the Remnant take the town back (flag town_retaken; standing.town_retaken with the locals): hostile, or on your side on the dark master's oath. Holding all seven outposts again gives it back to the locals. 'posts': which soldier profile the locals put on each post (outposts: the location's guard points; barracks: the town's trooper markers; a post left out stays empty).

gate.note: While the Remnant hold the gate, each outpost they have lost makes them edgier: from strict_from lost outposts the checkpoint band is one worse, and every lost outpost raises bribes by bribe_per_lost (0.25 = +25%). Seven outposts: strict from three lost, bribes up to 2.75x.
